ETHEREUM_PROVIDER_<CHAIN_NAME>.description: Custom RPC URL for a specific EVM-compatible chain, overriding the default RPC URL inferred from the viem/chains configuration.

TEE_MODE.description: Sets the Trusted Execution Environment mode. When set to any value other than 'OFF', the application will attempt to use a TEE-derived wallet.

WALLET_SECRET_SALT.description: Secret salt used to deterministically derive an ECDSA keypair inside the Trusted Execution Environment when TEE_MODE is enabled.

EVM_PROVIDER_<CHAIN_NAME>.description: Alternative variable name for specifying the RPC URL of a specific EVM chain (e.g., EVM_PROVIDER_MAINNET, EVM_PROVIDER_BASE). Used when ETHEREUM_PROVIDER_<CHAIN_NAME> is not set.

TEST_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private key to be used for tests; if absent a random key is generated.

FUNDED_TEST_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private key of a wallet pre-funded with testnet ETH for integration and end-to-end tests.

SEPOLIA_RPC_URL.description: Custom RPC endpoint URL for the Sepolia Ethereum testnet.

BASE_SEPOLIA_RPC_URL.description: Custom RPC endpoint URL for the Base Sepolia testnet.

OP_SEPOLIA_RPC_URL.description: Custom RPC endpoint URL for the Optimism Sepolia testnet.

DEBUG.description: Enables verbose logging when set (e.g., DEBUG=1).
